rendered: The enzyme was a water-forming NADH oxidase, expressed in Serratia marcescens H32 (the H32-nox construct). Its source was[1] nox from Lactobacillus brevis[2]. Its expression increased the NAD+/NADH ratio increasing the NAD^+/NADH ratio by 2.9-fold[3] and redirected flux toward acetoin[4]. Fed-batch fermentation then yielded 75.2[5] g/L of acetoin, so acetoin rose in the engineered strain.
